description: Register a dagster-snowflake SnowflakeResource for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

account.label: Account
account.description: Snowflake account identifier, e.g. 'xy12345.us-east-1'. Set this or account_env_var.

user.label: User
user.description: Snowflake username. Set this or user_env_var.

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the Snowflake password. Set exactly one of password_env_var / pat_env_var / private_key_path_env_var.

account_env_var.label: Account Env Var
account_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the Snowflake account identifier (secret-hygiene alternative to the plain `account` field -- account identifiers differ per environment, so teams often keep this out of checked-in YAML too).

user_env_var.label: User Env Var
user_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the Snowflake username.

pat_env_var.label: Pat Env Var
pat_env_var.description: Environment variable holding a Snowflake Programmatic Access Token (passed as the connector's password field -- same convention as snowflake_stored_procedure_call_asset).

private_key_path_env_var.label: Private Key Path Env Var
private_key_path_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the path to an RSA private key file, for key-pair authentication.

private_key_passphrase_env_var.label: Private Key Passphrase Env Var
private_key_passphrase_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the private key file's passphrase, if it's encrypted. Only used with private_key_path_env_var.

name: Snowflake Resource
